source.text: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥דהָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה בְּנֵ֣י אֵלִ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃

records.literal_gloss: A psalm of David. Ascribe to YHWH, sons of gods, ascribe to YHWH glory and strength.

en.L: A psalm of David. Ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, sons of gods, ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} glory and strength.
en.B: A psalm of David. Acknowledge {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you heavenly beings; acknowledge that glory and strength belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: A song of David. All you beings who live in heaven, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Say how glorious and strong {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is!

fr.L: Un psaume de David. Donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, fils des dieux, donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} gloire et force.
fr.B: Psaume de David. Reconnaissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous, êtres célestes ; reconnaissez que la gloire et la force appartiennent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Un chant de David. Vous tous qui vivez dans le ciel, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Dites combien {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est glorieux et fort !

sw.L: Zaburi ya Daudi. Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi wana wa miungu, mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu na nguvu.
sw.B: Zaburi ya Daudi. Mkirini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi viumbe wa mbinguni; kirini kwamba utukufu na nguvu ni mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Wimbo wa Daudi. Enyi viumbe wote mnaoishi mbinguni, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Semeni jinsi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyo mtukufu na mwenye nguvu!

es.L: Un salmo de David. {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, hijos de dioses, {{plural_you:den|dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} gloria y fuerza.
es.B: Un salmo de David. {{plural_you:Reconozcan|Reconoced}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, seres celestiales; {{plural_you:reconozcan|reconoced}} que la gloria y la fuerza pertenecen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Un canto de David. ¡Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, seres que viven en el cielo, {{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! ¡{{plural_you:Digan|Decid}} lo glorioso y fuerte que es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}!

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: sons of gods: the heavenly beings around God's throne
decisions.reason: The phrase (bene 'elim) is used again in 89:7 for the heavenly beings in God's council (compare Job 1:6). They are called to give the LORD the honor that is his.

decisions.choice: Ascribe: give, acknowledge
decisions.reason: The verb (havu) is "give!"; here, give the LORD the recognition due to him. It is repeated three times (verses 1-2).

decisions.choice: a psalm of the storm
decisions.reason: The psalm describes a great storm and names "the voice of the LORD" seven times. Canaanite poems found at Ugarit describe their storm god in similar language; here all that power belongs to the LORD alone.

decisions.choice: praise; say how glorious and strong
decisions.reason: Readable says what giving glory to God means (m2).

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1.

decisions.choice: "un psaume" for mizmor at Literal and Balanced, "un chant" at Readable, for the whole block
decisions.reason: As the Psalms terms note sets: "psaume" is the traditional word, and Readable uses the plainer "chant", as the English Readable says "song".

decisions.choice: "Donnez au SEIGNEUR" at Literal for hāḇû; "Reconnaissez" at Balanced; "louez" at Readable
decisions.reason: The verb is the ordinary "give". Literal keeps it, so that the reader sees that glory is given to God by being acknowledged; Balanced says what the giving is (m3).

decisions.choice: "zaburi" for a psalm in titles (L, B); "wimbo" (a song) at Readable
decisions.reason: "Zaburi" is the name Swahili gives to these poems; Readable says "wimbo", the everyday word, as the English Readable says "song".

decisions.choice: "Mkirini BWANA ... kirini" (acknowledge the LORD) at Balanced; "Mpeni" (give) at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is "give", but no one can give God glory he lacks; the sense is to declare that it is his. Literal keeps "give"; Balanced uses "kukiri", to acknowledge openly.

decisions.choice: un salmo (L, B); un canto (R)
decisions.reason: Mizmor is "un salmo" at Literal and Balanced and "un canto" at Readable, as the English has "psalm" and "song"; every title in these psalms follows this.

decisions.choice: plural_you setting on the commands to the heavenly beings
decisions.reason: The heavenly beings are addressed as a group, so the plural verbs and pronouns carry the plural_you setting ("den" or "dad").

source.text: הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Ascribe to YHWH [the] glory of his name; bow down to YHWH in [the] splendor of holiness.

en.L: Ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the glory of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; bow down to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in [the] splendor of holiness.
en.B: Acknowledge the glory that belongs to the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; bow before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in holy splendor.
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for how glorious {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name is. Bow down to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in holy splendor.

fr.L: Donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; prosternez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans [la] splendeur de la sainteté.
fr.B: Reconnaissez la gloire qui revient au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; inclinez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans une sainte splendeur.
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. Prosternez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans une sainte splendeur.

sw.L: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu wa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; msujudieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika uzuri wa utakatifu.
sw.B: Kirini utukufu unaolistahili jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; inameni mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika fahari takatifu.
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni tukufu. Msujudieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika fahari takatifu.

es.L: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; {{plural_you:póstrense|postraos}} ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en [el] esplendor de [la] santidad.
es.B: {{plural_you:Reconozcan|Reconoced}} la gloria que pertenece al nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; {{plural_you:inclínense|inclinaos}} ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en santo esplendor.
es.R: {{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por lo glorioso que es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. {{plural_you:Póstrense|Postraos}} ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en santo esplendor.

decisions.choice: the splendor of holiness: holy splendor
decisions.reason: The phrase (hadrat qodesh) may describe the splendor of the holy God, or the festal dress of worshipers (1 Chronicles 16:29; Psalm 96:9). The words are kept open.

decisions.choice: his name: God as he is known
decisions.reason: As in 5:12.

decisions.choice: bow down: worship
decisions.reason: The verb (hishtachavah) is to bow low before a king or God, and so to worship.

source.text: ק֥וֹל יְהוָ֗ה עַל־הַ֫מָּ֥יִם אֵֽל־הַכָּב֥וֹד הִרְעִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל־מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] voice of YHWH [is] over the waters; the God of glory thunders; YHWH [is] over many waters.

en.L: The voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] over the waters; the God of glory thunders, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, over many waters.
en.B: The voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sounds over the waters; the glorious God thunders; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is above the vast waters.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s voice is heard over the sea. The glorious God speaks like thunder. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} rules over the great waters.

fr.L: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] sur les eaux ; le Dieu de gloire tonne, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sur les grandes eaux.
fr.B: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} retentit sur les eaux ; le Dieu glorieux fait gronder le tonnerre ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est au-dessus des eaux immenses.
fr.R: On entend la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sur la mer. Le Dieu glorieux parle comme le tonnerre. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} règne sur les grandes eaux.

sw.L: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [iko] juu ya maji; Mungu wa utukufu anapiga radi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, juu ya maji mengi.
sw.B: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inasikika juu ya maji; Mungu mtukufu anapiga radi; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko juu ya maji makuu.
sw.R: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inasikika juu ya bahari. Mungu mtukufu anasema kama radi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anatawala juu ya maji makuu.

es.L: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [está] sobre las aguas; el Dios de gloria truena, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, sobre muchas aguas.
es.B: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} resuena sobre las aguas; el Dios glorioso truena; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está sobre las aguas inmensas.
es.R: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se oye sobre el mar. El Dios glorioso habla como un trueno. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reina sobre las grandes aguas.

decisions.choice: the voice of the LORD: the thunder
decisions.reason: In the storm, thunder is heard as God's voice (18:14; Job 37:4-5).

decisions.choice: the waters, many waters: the sea and its power
decisions.reason: The great waters stand for the forces of chaos that God rules (Genesis 1:2; Psalm 93:3-4).

decisions.choice: rules over
decisions.reason: Readable says what being over the waters means (m2).

records.literal_gloss: [The] voice of YHWH [is] in power; [the] voice of YHWH [is] in majesty.

en.L: The voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] in power; the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] in majesty.
en.B: The voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is mighty; the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is splendid as a king.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s voice is strong. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s voice is grand and royal.

fr.L: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] avec puissance ; la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] avec majesté.
fr.B: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est puissante ; la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a la splendeur d’un roi.
fr.R: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est forte. La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est grandiose, comme celle d’un roi.

sw.L: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [iko] katika nguvu; sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [iko] katika enzi.
sw.B: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ina nguvu nyingi; sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ina fahari ya kifalme.
sw.R: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ina nguvu. Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni kuu na ya kifalme.

es.L: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [es] con poder; la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [es] con majestad.
es.B: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es poderosa; la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tiene el esplendor de un rey.
es.R: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es fuerte. La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es grandiosa y digna de un rey.

decisions.choice: majesty: royal splendor
decisions.reason: The word (hadar) is the splendor of a king (8:6; 45:4).

source.text: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה שֹׁבֵ֣ר אֲרָזִ֑ים וַיְשַׁבֵּ֥ר יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֶת־אַרְזֵ֥י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] voice of YHWH [is] breaking cedars, and YHWH shattered the cedars of the Lebanon.

en.L: The voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} breaks cedars; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
en.B: The voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} snaps cedar trees; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} smashes the cedars of Lebanon to pieces.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s voice breaks huge cedar trees. He breaks into pieces even the great cedars of Lebanon.

fr.L: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} brise des cèdres ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fracasse les cèdres du Liban.
fr.B: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} casse les cèdres ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} met en pièces les cèdres du Liban.
fr.R: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} brise d’énormes cèdres. Il met en morceaux même les grands cèdres du Liban.

sw.L: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inavunja mierezi; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaivunjavunja mierezi ya Lebanoni.
sw.B: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inaivunja miti ya mierezi; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaipasua mierezi ya Lebanoni vipande vipande.
sw.R: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inavunja miti mikubwa ya mierezi. Anaivunja vipande vipande hata mierezi mikubwa ya Lebanoni.

es.L: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} quiebra cedros; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} despedaza los cedros del Líbano.
es.B: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} parte los cedros; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hace pedazos los cedros del Líbano.
es.R: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} quiebra cedros enormes. Hasta los grandes cedros del Líbano los rompe en pedazos.

decisions.choice: the cedars of Lebanon: the greatest of trees
decisions.reason: The cedars of the Lebanon mountains were the tallest and strongest trees known, a picture of what is mighty and proud (Isaiah 2:13; Psalm 104:16).

decisions.choice: shatters: a scene described as it happens
decisions.reason: The verb form is a past narrative form, used here in a vivid description; it is rendered in the present like the rest of the storm.

source.text: וַיַּרְקִידֵ֥ם כְּמוֹ־עֵ֑גֶל לְבָנ֥וֹן וְ֝שִׂרְיֹ֗ן כְּמ֣וֹ בֶן־רְאֵמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he makes them skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young one of wild oxen.

en.L: He makes them skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.
en.B: He sets Lebanon jumping like a calf and Sirion bucking like a young wild ox.
en.R: He makes the mountains of Lebanon and Mount Hermon shake. They jump around like a young calf or a young wild ox.

fr.L: Il les fait bondir comme un veau, le Liban et le Sirion comme un jeune buffle.
fr.B: Il fait sauter le Liban comme un veau, et le Sirion ruer comme un jeune buffle.
fr.R: Il fait trembler les montagnes du Liban et le mont Hermon. Elles sautent comme un jeune veau ou un jeune buffle.

sw.L: Anaifanya irukeruke kama ndama, Lebanoni na Sirioni kama mtoto wa nyati.
sw.B: Anaifanya Lebanoni iruke kama ndama, na Sirioni irukaruka kama nyati mchanga.
sw.R: Anaifanya milima ya Lebanoni na Mlima Hermoni itetemeke. Inaruka kama ndama mchanga au kama nyati mchanga.

es.L: Los hace saltar como un becerro; al Líbano y al Sirión, como una cría de buey salvaje.
es.B: Hace brincar al Líbano como un becerro y al Sirión como un buey salvaje joven.
es.R: Hace temblar los montes del Líbano y el monte Hermón. Saltan como un becerro o como un buey salvaje joven.

decisions.choice: Sirion: Mount Hermon
decisions.reason: Sirion is the name the Sidonians gave to Mount Hermon (Deuteronomy 3:9), the high mountain north of Israel. Lebanon here is the mountain range.

decisions.choice: them: Lebanon and Sirion
decisions.reason: "Them" may point ahead to the two mountains named next, or back to the cedars; either way the mountains shake in the storm like animals leaping.

decisions.choice: Mount Hermon
decisions.reason: Readable uses the better-known name (m1).

decisions.choice: "un jeune buffle" for the young of the rəʾēm, the wild ox
decisions.reason: The rəʾēm is the wild ox (the aurochs), now extinct. French has no common word for it; "buffle" names a large wild bovine a French reader can picture.

records.literal_gloss: [The] voice of YHWH hews flames of fire.

en.L: The voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} hews out flames of fire.
en.B: The voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} carves out flames of fire.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s voice sends out bolts of lightning.

fr.L: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} taille des flammes de feu.
fr.B: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fait jaillir des flammes de feu.
fr.R: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} lance des éclairs.

sw.L: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inachonga miali ya moto.
sw.B: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inachonga ndimi za moto.
sw.R: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inatuma radi za umeme.

es.L: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} labra llamas de fuego.
es.B: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} talla llamas de fuego.
es.R: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} lanza rayos.

decisions.choice: hews flames of fire: sends out lightning
decisions.reason: The verb (chatsav) is to cut or hew stone; the lightning is pictured as fire split out by God's voice.

decisions.choice: bolts of lightning
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

source.text: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה יָחִ֣יל מִדְבָּ֑ר יָחִ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִדְבַּ֥ר קָדֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] voice of YHWH makes [the] wilderness writhe; YHWH makes [the] wilderness of Kadesh writhe.

en.L: The voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} makes [the] wilderness writhe; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} makes the wilderness of Kadesh writhe.
en.B: The voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sets the desert trembling; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} makes the Kadesh desert quake.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s voice makes the desert shake. He makes the desert of Kadesh tremble.

fr.L: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fait se tordre [le] désert ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait se tordre le désert de Kadesh.
fr.B: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fait trembler le désert ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait frémir le désert de Kadesh.
fr.R: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fait trembler le désert. Il fait trembler le désert de Kadesh.

sw.L: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inalitetemesha jangwa; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analitetemesha jangwa la Kadeshi.
sw.B: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inalifanya jangwa litetemeke; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analitikisa jangwa la Kadeshi.
sw.R: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inalitikisa jangwa. Analifanya jangwa la Kadeshi litetemeke.

es.L: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} hace retorcerse [al] desierto; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hace retorcerse al desierto de Cades.
es.B: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} hace temblar el desierto; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sacude el desierto de Cades.
es.R: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} hace temblar el desierto. Hace estremecer el desierto de Cades.

decisions.choice: writhe: shake, tremble as in labor
decisions.reason: The verb (chul) is used of writhing in pain, as a woman in labor; verse 9 uses it of the deer.

decisions.choice: Kadesh: the southern desert
alternatives: Kadesh on the Orontes river in Syria
decisions.reason: Kadesh is probably Kadesh-barnea in the wilderness south of Israel (Numbers 20:1), so the storm sweeps from Lebanon in the north to the desert in the south. Some think of another Kadesh in Syria, north of Lebanon.

source.text: ק֤וֹל יְהוָ֨ה׀יְחוֹלֵ֣ל אַיָּלוֹת֮ וַֽיֶּחֱשֹׂ֪ף יְעָ֫ר֥וֹת וּבְהֵיכָל֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ אֹמֵ֥ר כָּבֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] voice of YHWH makes does give birth, and strips forests bare; and in his temple all of it says, Glory!

en.L: The voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} makes [the] does give birth and strips [the] forests bare; and in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple everything says, "Glory!"
en.B: The voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} brings the does to labor and leaves the woods stripped; and in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple everyone shouts, "Glory!"
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s voice makes deer give birth. It tears the leaves off the trees in the forest. And in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple everyone shouts, "Glory!"

fr.L: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fait enfanter [les] biches et dépouille [les] forêts ; et dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple tout dit : « Gloire ! »
fr.B: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fait mettre bas les biches et laisse les bois dénudés ; et dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple tous s’écrient : « Gloire ! »
fr.R: La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fait naître les petits des biches. Elle arrache les feuilles des arbres de la forêt. Et dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple, tout le monde crie : « Gloire ! »

sw.L: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inawafanya kulungu jike wazae, na kuyaacha misitu wazi; na katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kila kitu kinasema, "Utukufu!"
sw.B: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inawaletea kulungu jike uchungu wa kuzaa na kuiacha misitu bila majani; na katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} wote wanapaza sauti, "Utukufu!"
sw.R: Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inawafanya kulungu wazae. Inayang'oa majani ya miti msituni. Na katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} wote wanapaza sauti, "Utukufu!"

es.L: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} hace parir a [las] ciervas y deja desnudos [los] bosques; y en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo todo dice: «¡Gloria!».
es.B: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} hace que las ciervas se pongan de parto y deja los bosques pelados; y en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo todos gritan: «¡Gloria!».
es.R: La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} hace que las ciervas den a luz. Arranca las hojas de los árboles del bosque. Y en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo todos gritan: «¡Gloria!».

decisions.choice: does: female deer
decisions.reason: The word as the Hebrew text reads it means female deer, and the storm makes them give birth in fright. With different vowels the same letters mean "oaks" and the verb "whirls", which would pair with the forests. The Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: his temple: God's heavenly palace
decisions.reason: The heavenly beings called on in verse 1 answer from God's temple in heaven (11:4) with the cry "Glory!".

source.text: יְ֭הוָה לַמַּבּ֣וּל יָשָׁ֑ב וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יְ֝הוָ֗ה מֶ֣לֶךְ לְעוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH at the flood sat enthroned, and YHWH sits [as] king forever.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sat enthroned at the flood, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sits [as] King forever.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sat on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne above the flood; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is seated as King for all time.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was King over the great flood. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will be King forever.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est assis [en roi] sur le déluge, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} siège [comme] Roi pour toujours.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était assis sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône au-dessus du déluge ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} siège comme Roi pour toujours.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était Roi sur le grand déluge. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera Roi pour toujours.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliketi katika enzi wakati wa gharika, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaketi [kama] Mfalme milele.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliketi juu ya kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi juu ya gharika; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameketi kama Mfalme siku zote.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa Mfalme juu ya gharika kuu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa Mfalme milele.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se sentó entronizado en el diluvio, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se sienta [como] Rey para siempre.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se sentó en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono sobre el diluvio; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está sentado como Rey por todos los tiempos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} era Rey sobre el gran diluvio. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será Rey para siempre.

decisions.choice: the flood: the great flood of Noah's time
decisions.reason: The word (mabbul) is used elsewhere only of the flood in Genesis 6-11. The LORD who ruled over that flood rules over every storm.

decisions.choice: sat: sat enthroned as king
decisions.reason: To sit (yashav) here is to sit on the throne and rule (2:4; 9:8).

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה עֹ֭זלְעַמּ֣וֹ יִתֵּ֑ן יְהוָ֓ה׀יְבָרֵ֖ךְ אֶת־עַמּ֣וֹ בַשָּׁלֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH strength to his people will give; YHWH will bless his people with the peace.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will give strength to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will bless {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people with peace.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people strong; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people the blessing of peace.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people strong. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will bless them and give them peace.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donnera la force à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} bénira {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple par la paix.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rendra {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple fort ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donnera à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple la bénédiction de la paix.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rendra {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple fort. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le bénira et lui donnera la paix.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawapa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} nguvu; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawabariki watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwa amani.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawafanya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kuwa na nguvu; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawapa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} baraka ya amani.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawafanya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kuwa na nguvu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawabariki na kuwapa amani.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dará fuerza a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} bendecirá a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo con paz.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará fuerte a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dará a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo la bendición de la paz.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará fuerte a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo bendecirá y le dará paz.

decisions.choice: will give, will bless: a promise
alternatives: may the LORD give ... may he bless (a prayer)
decisions.reason: The verbs can be read as a promise or as a wish; either way the strength of the storm is turned into strength for God's people.

decisions.choice: peace: wholeness and well-being
decisions.reason: The word (shalom) is more than the end of war: it is a life made whole. The psalm that began in a storm ends in peace.
